arabiziOrthographyPolicy.ages5To7: Transparent phonetic Latin letters without numeral substitutions (e.g., "Yalla niktishif il-lulu" — illustrative activity invitation, never presented as a standardized official Qatari orthography).
arabiziOrthographyPolicy.ages8To10: Clear phonetic Latin with side-by-side Arabic script and English gloss.
arabiziOrthographyPolicy.ages11To17: Allows optional familiar Arabizi digits (3 = ع, 7 = ح, 5 = خ) accompanied by explicit phonetic explanations.

bedrockSurfaceCapabilityMatrix.finding: Microsoft Bedrock pack documentation lists 29 standard pack locale codes (en_US, fr_FR, etc.) and does NOT list ar_SA or ar_001. Adding fake codes to languages.json is prohibited.
bedrockSurfaceCapabilityMatrix.chosenStrategy: Keep languages.json restricted to valid Bedrock pack locales (en_US, fr_FR) and drive Arabic/Arabizi/English selection via in-world Script API player dynamic properties + RawMessage.

bedrockSurfaceCapabilityMatrix.finding: Modern Bedrock 1.21.50+ renders UTF-8 Arabic characters in Server-UI forms, but LTR container alignment and line-wrapping on small mobile/gamepad screens can clip long vocalized strings.
bedrockSurfaceCapabilityMatrix.chosenStrategy: Provide player-selectable Mode 1 (Native Arabic UTF-8 + English gloss), Mode 2 (Curated Arabizi Latin LTR + Arabic term), and Mode 3 (Plain English + side-by-side glossary). Default to user choice.

bedrockSurfaceCapabilityMatrix.finding: Short 2–4 word Arabic headers (e.g., عالم يرا · قطر) render cleanly, whereas mixed bidi numbers/punctuation in long actionbar tickers can reorder.
bedrockSurfaceCapabilityMatrix.chosenStrategy: Use concise isolated Arabic lines or Arabizi/English per player script preference without manual character reversal.

bedrockSurfaceCapabilityMatrix.finding: Hanging signs and NPC nametags have strict line-width limits; diacritics (tashkeel) increase vertical clipping risk.
bedrockSurfaceCapabilityMatrix.chosenStrategy: Use unvocalized clear Arabic + Arabizi/English bilingual nametags (e.g., "Noora · نورة") and Server-UI dialog panels for full story text.
